 const LEGEND_WEAPON={name:'전설의 조선무',atk:40};  const LEGEND_ARMOR={name:'황금장바구니방패',def:40};  const RPG_INN_PRICE=30;  const RPG_MEDICINE=[{id:'포션',price:80,desc:'HP 완전회복'},{id:'에테르',price:45,desc:'MP 완전회복'},{id:'성수',price:60,desc:'적에게 빛 피해'}];  function legendaryGearReady(){return (run.weaponLv||0)>=RPG_WEAPONS.length-1&&(run.armorLv||0)>=RPG_ARMORS.length-1}  function equippedWeapon(){return run.radish?LEGEND_WEAPON:RPG_WEAPONS[clamp(run.weaponLv||0,0,RPG_WEAPONS.length-1)]}  function equippedArmor(){return run.shield?LEGEND_ARMOR:RPG_ARMORS[clamp(run.armorLv||0,0,RPG_ARMORS.length-1)]}  function weaponBonus(){return equippedWeapon().atk}  function armorBonus(){return equippedArmor().def}  function accessory(){return RPG_ACCESSORIES[clamp(run.accessoryLv||0,0,RPG_ACCESSORIES.length-1)]}  function totalAtk(){return hero.atk+weaponBonus()+accessory().atk}  function totalDef(){return hero.def+armorBonus()+accessory().def}  function spendCoins(n){n=Math.max(0,Math.floor(n));if((state.coins||0)<n)return false;state.coins-=n;save();refresh();return true}  function shopOverlay(title,body){   const old=document.querySelector('.fantasyShopOverlay');if(old)old.remove();const w=document.createElement('div');w.className='fantasyShopOverlay';   w.innerHTML=`<div class="fantasyShopPanel"><div class="fantasyShopHead"><span>${title}</span><span class="fantasyShopCoin">🪙 ${state.coins||0}</span></div><div class="fantasyShopStat">공격 ${totalAtk()} · 방어 ${totalDef()}<br>무기: ${equippedWeapon().name}<br>방어구: ${equippedArmor().name}<br>장신구: ${RPG_ACCESSORIES[run.accessoryLv||0].name}</div>${body}<button class="fantasyShopClose">나가기</button></div>`;   wrap.appendChild(w);w.querySelector('.fantasyShopClose').onclick=()=>w.remove();return w  }  function openGearShop(kind){   const weapon=kind==='weapon',list=weapon?RP
   const w=shopOverlay(weapon?'⚔️ 중앙시장 무기점':'🛡️ 포목·방어구점',body),gb=w.querySelector('[data-buygear]');   if(gb)gb.onclick=()=>{const cur=weapon?(run.weaponLv||0):(run.armorLv||0),it=list[cur+1];if(!it||!spendCoins(it.price))return;if(weapon)run.weaponLv=cur+1;else run.armorLv=cur+1;tone('clear');buzz([15,8,28]);w.remove();openGearShop(kind);updateHud()};   const ab=w.querySelector('[data-buyacc]');if(ab)ab.onclick=()=>{const cur=run.accessoryLv||0,it=RPG_ACCESSORIES[cur+1];if(!it||!spendCoins(it.price))return;run.accessoryLv=cur+1;tone('clear');buzz([15,8,28]);w.remove();openGearShop(kind);updateHud()}  }  function openPharmacy(){   const body=RPG_MEDICINE.map(it=>`<div class="fantasyShopItem"><div><b>${it.id}</b><br><small>${it.desc} · 보유 ${run.inventory[it.id]||0}개</small></div><button data-med="${it.id}" ${(state.coins||0)<it.price?'disabled':''}>🪙 ${it.price}</button></div>`).join(''),w=shopOverlay('💊 중앙시장 약방',body);   w.querySelectorAll('[data-med]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const it=RPG_MEDICINE.find(x=>x.id===b.dataset.med);if(!it||!spendCoins(it.price))return;run.inventory[it.id]=(run.inventory[it.id]||0)+1;tone('coin');buzz(12);w.remove();openPharmacy();updateHud()})  }  function merchantTalk(npc,actions,hint=''){   const old=document.querySelector('.fantasyShopOverlay');if(old)old.remove();   const w=document.createElement('div');w.className='fantasyShopOverlay fantasyMerchantTalk';   const line=npcDialog(npc);   w.innerHTML=`<div class="fantasyShopPanel"><div class="fantasyShopHead"><span>${npc.name}</span><span class="fantasyShopCoin">🪙 ${state.coins||0}</span></div><div class="fantasyMerchantSpeech">${line}</div>${hint?`<div class="fantasyMerchantHint">${hint}</div>`:''}<div class="fantasyMerchantActions">${actions.map((a,i)=>`<button data-merchant-action="${i}" ${a.disabled?'disabled':''}>${a.label}</button>`).join('')}</div><button class="fantasyShopClose">대화 끝내기</button></div>`;   wrap.appendChild(w);   w.querySelector('.fantasyShopClose').onclick=()=>w.remove();   w.querySelectorAll('[data-merchant-action]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const a=actions[Number(b.dataset.merchantAction)];if(!a||a.disabled)return;w.remove();a.action()});   tone('good');updateHud();return w  }  function offerWeaponShop(npc){   if(legendaryGearReady()&&!run.legendUnlocked){    run.legendUnlocked=true;    tone('perfect
